explanation: Enter the name of the tool texture, followed by its description, this file will set that description for the specific game, overriding the global one if it exists
materials/tools/toolsclip.vmat: General purpose clip, blocks players, physics objects, and NPCs, compiles into the physics mesh only, in CS2 it will take on the footstep sounds of the mesh below it
materials/tools/toolsblockbomb.vmat: Legacy tool material, do not use, use normal clip and trigger_bomb_reset to block the C4 item instead
